items: AntiAliasingPass: Anti-Aliasing Post-Process Pass. Samples the intermediate scene-color texture (rendered at AA resolution) and writes the final, resolved image into the swap-chain canvas texture using the engine's configured AA shader (SSAA / Bilinear). This is always the last GPU pass in the frame. It is marked unculled so the FrameGraph never strips it.
